title: About us · Know The Company
h1: Helping people choose companies they can trust
intro: Know The Company is an open review platform for startups and growing companies, everywhere. Big brands already have thousands of reviews; the companies people actually hire, work with and work for often have none. Anyone can read and write reviews for free. We show how a company treats both its customers and its employees.
